plugins.name: session-metrics
plugins.description: Per-turn token, cost, and cache analytics for Claude Code sessions. Multi-format export (text/JSON/CSV/MD/HTML) with session blocks, weekly roll-up, subagent attribution, dynamic-workflow tracking, and 9-category turn waste classification. HTML reports include cost timeline, hour-of-day punchcard, model-switch dividers, cache-break badges, a per-turn detail drawer, and a per-request breakdown that groups turns by the prompt that drove them. Sibling skills: audit-session-metrics audits exports for waste patterns (summarisation-only — run on /model haiku for ~10× cheaper); task-breakdown groups requests into semantic tasks with worth-it / wasted verdicts and a Tasks companion page. Zero network, stdlib-only Python.

plugins.name: plezuz-statusline
plugins.description: Fork of centminmod's desktop-statusline: a compact one-line status band in the Claude Desktop Code tab — cost, tokens, prompt-cache time left and hit rate by default; every other element switchable. Requires Claude Code v2.1.287+.
